correctness.rationale: The actual 25-edge graph on 15 labelled vertices was independently reconstructed. Exhaustive matching recursion yielded 9,213 augmented faces of cardinalities (1,25,240,1125,2710,3227,1645,240). Edge-coordinate staged matching gives 4,586 disjoint acyclic pairs, verified by a topological sort of all 9,213 nodes/42,405 Hasse incidences. This leaves 31 critical 4-faces, ten 5-faces, and an ordinary vertex. Recomputed signed integral 31x10 gradient differential, exact Smith diagonal seven units, with no torsion. Since the Morse CW model has no 1-,2-,3-cells, it is 3-connected and the 5-cell maps are classified by pi4 of the wedge of S4; seven primitive cancellations leave 24 S4 and 3 S5. All claims are finite for the specified graph, with no extrapolation.
